segments.name: Pest Control
segments.description: Provides pest control services including general pest maintenance and termite management for customers globally.
segments.evidence: Pest Control: the Group offers a range of services, with the most common being general pest maintenance contracts.

segments.name: Hygiene & Wellbeing
segments.description: Provides washroom equipment, consumables and servicing as well as related hygiene and wellbeing services.
segments.evidence: Hygiene & Wellbeing: the Group offers a similar type of service to Pest Control, providing washroom equipment, consumables, and a technician to service the washroom.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Group for pest control and hygiene services delivered under full-service contracts, recognized over the contract duration or at completion.
revenueModel.evidence: These are mainly full-service contracts, inclusive of equipment, maintenance, and consumables as required.

changes.text: In 2022, the company acquired Terminix Global Holdings, Inc., the most recognised brand in U.S. termite and pest management services.
changes.evidence: In 2022, we acquired Terminix Global Holdings, Inc. ("Terminix"), the most recognised brand in U.S. termite and pest management services.
